meta.title: Elega
meta.description: A social network for friends, family and communities.

home.headline: Friends, family and communities in one place
home.lead: Elega is getting ready for a closed alpha. The feed, messages, groups and events will appear here.
home.newPosts: {count, plural, =0 {No new posts} one {# new post} other {# new posts}}
home.verifyBanner: Confirm {email}: we've sent you a link. Some features stay off until you do.

errors.generic: Something went wrong. Please try again.

emails.footer: This is a service email from Elega. If this wasn't you, change your password and sign out of all sessions in your security settings.

verify_email.subject: Confirm your email address
verify_email.body: Confirm your email address to use Elega fully. The link is valid for 24 hours.

change_email_confirm.subject: Confirm your new email address
change_email_confirm.body: You entered this address as the new email for your Elega account. The link is valid for 24 hours.

change_email_notice.subject: Email change requested
change_email_notice.body: Someone asked to change the email of your account. It changes only after the new address is confirmed.

reset_password.subject: Reset your password
reset_password.body: We received a request to reset your password. The link works once and is valid for 1 hour. If you didn't ask for this, ignore this email.

password_changed.subject: Your password was changed
password_changed.body: The password of your account was changed and your other sessions were signed out.

new_device_login.subject: Sign-in from a new device
new_device_login.body: Your account was signed in from a new device: {device}. Time: {time}.

two_factor_enabled.subject: Two-factor authentication is on
two_factor_enabled.body: Signing in now needs a code from your authenticator app. Keep your recovery codes somewhere safe.

two_factor_disabled.subject: Two-factor authentication is off
two_factor_disabled.body: Signing in no longer needs a code from your authenticator app.

provider_linked.subject: Sign-in method linked
provider_linked.body: Sign-in with {provider} was linked to your account.

mfa.title: Confirm sign-in
mfa.lead: Enter the code from your authenticator app or one of your recovery codes.
mfa.hint: 6 digits from the app, or a 10-character recovery code

signup.title: Create an account
signup.lead: Create an account to keep in touch with friends, family and communities.
signup.completeLead: You're signing up with {provider}. Just a few more details.
signup.passwordHint: At least {min} characters. A phrase of a few words works well.
signup.usernameHint: Latin letters, digits, dots and underscores, 3 to 30 characters.
signup.birthdateHint: You must be at least {age} to sign up.
signup.inviteHint: The code from your invitation, e.g. ABCD-EFGH-JKMN-PQRS.
signup.acceptTerms: I accept the <terms>terms of service</terms> and the <privacy>privacy policy</privacy>
signup.acceptPd: I give my <consent>consent to the processing of personal data</consent>

forgot.title: Reset your password
forgot.lead: Enter your account email and we'll send you a link to set a new password.
forgot.sent: If an account with this email exists, a message is on its way. The link is valid for 1 hour.

reset.title: New password
reset.lead: Choose a new password. Saving it signs you out on every device.
reset.done: Password changed. Sign in with your new password.

errors.network: Couldn't reach the server. Check your connection.
errors.rate_limited: Too many attempts. Wait a little and try again.
errors.unauthorized: Your session has expired. Sign in again.
errors.conflict: The data has changed. Reload the page and try again.
errors.consent_required: You need to accept this to sign up.
errors.token_invalid: This link is invalid or has expired. Request a new one.
errors.code_required: Enter the code from your app or a recovery code.
errors.email_taken: An account with this email already exists. Sign in or reset your password.
errors.email_domain_not_allowed: Addresses on this domain aren't accepted. Use another email.
errors.username_format: Latin letters, digits, dots and underscores only, 3 to 30 characters.
errors.username_consecutive_dots: Two dots in a row aren't allowed.
errors.username_cooldown: You can change your username once every 14 days.
errors.password_too_weak: This password is too simple or too common. Add more words.
errors.recent_sign_in_required: Sign in again to do this.
errors.birthdate_invalid: Enter your real date of birth.
errors.birthdate_too_young: You must be at least 14 to sign up.
errors.invite_invalid: This invite code is not valid or has already been used.
errors.version_outdated: The documents have been updated. Reload the page and accept the new version.
errors.account_banned: This account has been banned for breaking the rules.
errors.not_allowed_for_minors: This setting isn't available until you are 18.
errors.display_name_invalid: The name contains characters that are not allowed.

oauthErrors.expired: Sign-in took too long. Try again.
oauthErrors.provider_error: The sign-in service didn't respond. Try later or sign in with your password.
oauthErrors.account_exists: An account with this email already exists. Sign in with your password, then link this sign-in method in your security settings.
oauthErrors.account_banned: This account has been banned for breaking the rules.
oauthErrors.signin_required: Sign in first to link a sign-in method.
oauthErrors.already_linked: This external account is already linked to another Elega user.
oauthErrors.provider_already_linked: Another account from this service is already linked to you.

account.usernameHint: You can change it once every 14 days. Your old username keeps pointing to you for 30 days and nobody else can take it.

email.title: Email
email.changeSent: We've sent a link to {email}. Your address changes once you confirm it.

security.passwordChanged: Password changed. Your other sessions have been signed out.
security.noPassword: You sign in with VK ID or Yandex ID. To set a password, use password recovery on the sign-in page.

twoFactor.title: Two-factor authentication
twoFactor.description: Besides your password, you'll need a code from an authenticator app to sign in.
twoFactor.staffRequired: Staff accounts must use two-factor authentication.
twoFactor.scan: Scan the QR code with your authenticator app and enter the code it shows.
twoFactor.qrAlt: QR code for your authenticator app
twoFactor.manual: Can't scan it? Enter the key manually
twoFactor.recovery: Save these recovery codes. Each works once and lets you sign in without your phone. We won't show them again.

sessions.title: Sessions
sessions.description: Devices where you are signed in.

providers.title: Sign-in methods
providers.description: External accounts you can use to sign in to Elega.
providers.lastMethod: This is your only sign-in method. Set a password first.
providers.none: External sign-in methods are not available right now.

privacy.minorNotice: Until you turn 18, some privacy settings are limited to keep you safe.
privacy.minorLimited: Some options are unavailable until you are 18.
privacy.whoCanSendFriendRequests: Who can send me friend requests
privacy.whoCanSeeOnlineStatus: Who can see when I'm online
privacy.defaultPostAudience: Who sees my posts by default
privacy.readReceiptsEnabled: Show when I've read a message
privacy.searchEngineIndexing: Show my profile in search engines
privacy.discoverableByEmail: Let people find me by email address

legal.pending: The text is being prepared and will be published after legal review. Until then Elega runs only as an invite-only closed test.

terms.title: Terms of service
terms.summary: The rules for using Elega: what you can post, how we handle reports and what happens when rules are broken.

privacy.title: Privacy policy
privacy.summary: What data we collect and why, where it is stored, and how you can export or delete it.

pdProcessing.title: Consent to personal data processing
pdProcessing.summary: Consent under Russian Federal Law No. 152-FZ: which personal data is processed, for what purpose, and how to withdraw consent.
